h1: The 6 Best Hose Reel Carts Under $200 of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Hose Reel Carts Under $200: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 6 hose reel carts under $200 scored on hose capacity, guide design, wheels and fittings, from WERMAH 300 ft to Giraffe Tools.
summary: The WERMAH 4-Wheel cart with a POM guide is the best in the group: 300 ft of 5/8 inch hose, stainless rods and an angled brass connector. The second WERMAH adds 10 inch airless tires, the Real Hose Storage cart has the best crank, and the VEVOR is the budget way to hold 300 ft. The Giraffe 200 ft is for thinner 1/2 inch hose only.
intro: Capacity numbers on hose reel carts hide a trap. The 300 ft figure assumes a particular hose diameter, and the moment you wind 3/4 inch hose onto a reel sized for 5/8 inch you will fit about half. Almost every cart here quotes its capacity for 5/8 inch hose, so match that to the hose you already own before you trust the number on the box.

We ranked six carts that sit under $200, weighing hose capacity first, then the guide that keeps hose from piling up on one side, the wheels and the fittings. Everything is taken from the listings. Where one lists a conflicting detail, we ignore it rather than repeat a doubtful claim.

products.name: WERMAH 4-Wheel Hose Reel Cart With POM Guide 300 ft
products.verdict: 300 ft of 5/8 inch hose with a POM guide, stainless rods and an angled brass connector.
products.description:
WERMAH holds 300 ft of 5/8 inch hose on four wheels and fits a POM hose guide with PU/TPU belts on 304 stainless rods. An angled one-piece brass connector with precision seals joins the hose, and a 6.5 ft leader hose is included.

The guide is the decisive part. Without one, hose winds unevenly and kinks at the edge of the reel, and a guide that lays it level keeps long hose from jamming. Stainless rods and POM do not corrode, which matters on a cart that stays damp. It edges out the second WERMAH on the guide design, even though the other has stated 10 inch tires.

Buy it for a large yard with a long run of hose. The listing does not give tire details, so check the wheels on gravel or lawn.
products.idealFor: Large yards with long hose runs.
products.skipIf: You roll across rough ground and need proven tires.

products.name: WERMAH 4-Wheel Hose Reel Cart 300 ft
products.verdict: Same 300 ft capacity with 10 inch non-slip airless tires, a foam crank grip and a basket.
products.description:
This WERMAH holds 300 ft of 5/8 inch hose on four 10 inch non-slip airless wheels. It has an angled brass connector with precision seals, a 6.5 ft leader hose, a foam-padded crank grip and a storage basket.

Airless tires cannot go flat, and 10 inches is large enough to climb a curb or roll over a lawn, which is why this version wins on mobility. Its weak spot is the missing guide in the spec list, and long hose without one tends to wind to one side. The padded grip makes a long winding job less tiring.

Buy it for uneven yards where wheels matter more than guide design. Bring the hose in often to stop it kinking, since nothing here levels it as it winds.
cons: Same bucket as the guided model
products.idealFor: Uneven lawns and gravel where tires decide usability.

products.name: Real Hose Storage 4-Wheel Hose Reel Cart 250 ft
products.verdict: 250 ft of 5/8 inch hose with an ergonomic crank, powder-coated steel and airless tires.
products.description:
Real Hose Storage uses a powder-coated, rust-resistant steel frame, an E-Z Ergo crank with a foam-padded grip, non-slip airless tires on four wheels and a 6 ft leader hose. It holds 250 ft of 5/8 inch hose.

Its crank is the reason to choose it. Winding 250 ft of wet hose is the real chore, and a larger, padded handle spreads that effort out. It ranks third because it holds 50 ft less than the WERMAH models and has no hose guide in the listing. Against the Giraffe 250 it swaps the pre-installed guide for a better crank.

Buy it for a mid-size yard where comfort matters. The 250 ft limit means it falls short for properties with a very long run.
products.idealFor: Mid-size yards where winding comfort matters.
products.skipIf: You have more than 250 ft of hose.

products.name: Giraffe Tools 250 ft Hose Reel Cart
products.verdict: 250 ft of 5/8 inch hose, a pre-installed guide system and brass fittings.
products.description:
Giraffe Tools holds 250 ft of 5/8 inch hose on four wheels, with a pre-installed hose guide, brass fittings, a basket and an ergonomic non-slip handle.

A pre-installed guide is a real convenience. A guide you never have to fit cannot be installed wrongly, and a wrongly fitted one is what makes hose wind unevenly. It ranks fourth because the listing gives no tire type or frame material, unlike the Real Hose Storage, which names powder-coated steel and airless tires. Brass fittings are a plus on a part that sees constant pressure.

Buy it for a mid-size yard where you would rather not fiddle with the guide. The missing tire description is the gap, so confirm it before ordering.
products.idealFor: Mid-size yards where easy setup counts.
products.skipIf: You need to know the tire and frame details.

products.name: VEVOR 300 ft 4-Wheel Hose Reel Cart
products.verdict: 300 ft of 5/8 inch hose in the $50 to $100 bucket, with powder-coated steel and brass fittings.
products.description:
VEVOR holds 300 ft of 5/8 inch hose on a powder-coated steel frame, with brass fittings, a storage basket and a non-slip handle. It sits in the $50 to $100 bucket, below every other cart.

The price is the point. It matches the WERMAH capacity for a lot less money, which makes it the rational choice for someone who wants length rather than features. It ranks fifth because the listing is inconsistent about its wheel count, so we do not rely on that, and it does not describe a guide or leader hose. Treat it as the capacity value pick.

Buy it if you need 300 ft on a budget. Check the wheels before ordering, since the listing is unclear about them.
cons: No guide or leader hose listed
products.idealFor: Long hose runs on a limited budget.
products.skipIf: You need airless tires and a hose guide.

products.name: Giraffe Tools 200 ft Hose Reel Cart 1/2 Inch
products.verdict: 200 ft of 1/2 inch hose, or 150 ft of 5/8 inch, with a guide and a 5 ft lead-in hose.
products.description:
Giraffe Tools sizes this cart for 200 ft of 1/2 inch hose or 150 ft of 5/8 inch, with a hose guide system, a 5 ft lead-in hose and two solid knobby tires. The listing says it is not for 3/4 inch hose.

That honesty is useful, because it shows how capacity falls as diameter rises. It ranks last since 150 ft of 5/8 inch is half of what the WERMAH holds, and it has only two wheels. Yet it is the one built for light 1/2 inch hose, which is easier to handle and cheaper.

Buy it for a small yard with thin hose. Anyone with a 5/8 inch hose should step up to a larger reel, and 3/4 inch hose is out entirely.
products.idealFor: Small yards with thin 1/2 inch hose.

whatMatters.detail: Capacity is the length of hose the drum holds, and it changes with diameter. The Giraffe 200 ft cart holds 200 ft of 1/2 inch but only 150 ft of 5/8 inch. Check which diameter the number refers to, and match it to the hose you own before assuming the reel will hold it all, and leave a few feet of spare drum space.

A guide is the arm that lays hose evenly across the drum as you crank. Without it, hose piles at one edge and kinks, which cuts flow and wears the hose. The WERMAH uses POM and stainless rods, and the Giraffe 250 is pre-installed. Look for the word guide in the specs, not just a decorative arm.

Airless tires cannot puncture, and larger diameters roll over roots and lawn edges more easily. The WERMAH second model has 10 inch airless tires, while the Giraffe 200 ft uses solid knobby ones. Look for the tire type and size in the specs, and check the wheel count, since the number varies between models and affects how stable a full cart feels.

The connector links the drum to the tap, and it is where leaks start. Brass resists corrosion and threads, and an angled design keeps the hose from kinking at the joint. The WERMAH uses one-piece brass with seals. Look for a material and seal description, and check a leader hose is included for the tap, so you are not buying one separately.

A cart stays outdoors, so the frame must resist rust. Powder-coated steel and stainless components last longer than bare steel. The Real Hose Storage and VEVOR list powder coating, and the WERMAH lists 304 stainless rods. Check the frame line on the listing, and look at photos to see whether the finish covers welds and cut edges, where rust usually begins.

faq.a: Not on the Giraffe 200 ft, which says it is not for 3/4 inch hose. The other carts quote capacity for 5/8 inch, so 3/4 inch hose would fit much less. Check the drum size before buying.

faq.q: What is the common mistake with hose carts?
faq.a: Trusting a capacity number without checking diameter. The WERMAH holds 300 ft of 5/8 inch, but the Giraffe 200 ft holds only 150 ft of that size. Match the figure to your own hose.

faq.q: Is the guided WERMAH worth more than the tire model?
faq.a: If your yard is smooth, yes. The POM guide lays hose evenly on both models' 300 ft capacity. If your yard is rough, the second WERMAH's 10 inch airless tires matter more. Both sit in the $100 to $200 bucket.

faq.q: How do I set one up?
faq.a: Assemble the cart, then fit the leader hose to the connector and wind your hose onto the drum. The Giraffe 250 arrives with the guide pre-installed, which saves a step, while the Real Hose Storage includes a 6 ft leader.

faq.q: Do I need to drain the hose?
faq.a: Yes, before winter. Water left in a coiled hose can freeze and split it. Disconnect at the tap, crank the hose in with the end low to drain, and store the cart under cover in the cold months.
The WERMAH uses 304 stainless rods and the Real Hose Storage a powder-coated steel frame. Store any of them in shade to protect the hose and the finish, and wipe the guide clean of grit regularly.

finalTake: For most yards the WERMAH 4-Wheel cart with the POM guide is the right buy: 300 ft of 5/8 inch hose, stainless rods and an angled brass connector. Choose the other WERMAH if your ground is rough, the Real Hose Storage for crank comfort, and the VEVOR if you need 300 ft on a budget. The Giraffe 200 ft is only for thin hose.
